questions.question: How is the modern periodic table primarily ordered?
What is a vertical column of the periodic table called?
What is a horizontal row of the periodic table called?
Which group includes fluorine, chlorine, and bromine?
Which group includes helium, neon, and argon?
Where are most metals located on the periodic table?
choices: On the left and in the center

questions.question: Which symbol represents sodium?
Why do main-group elements in the same group often have similar chemical behavior?
choices: They have the same atomic mass

questions.question: How does atomic radius generally change down a main-group column?
choices: It remains identical for all members
It decreases because atoms lose their nuclei
It increases as additional occupied electron shells are added
It changes only when the element becomes a gas

questions.question: How does electronegativity generally change from left to right across a period, excluding noble-gas complications?
choices: It is identical for every element

questions.question: Why are noble gases relatively unreactive under many ordinary conditions?
choices: Their outer electron shells are filled

questions.question: What is ionization energy?
choices: The energy released when water freezes
Energy needed to remove a neutron from every isotope
Energy required to remove an electron from a gaseous atom or ion
Energy stored only in a metal's crystal shape

questions.question: Why do alkali metals commonly form +1 ions?
choices: They gain two electrons in ordinary compounds
They gain one proton during bonding
They lose one neutron during every reaction
They can lose one outer electron

questions.question: What does the periodic table reveal beyond a list of element names?
choices: Exact weather conditions during every reaction
The number of molecules in every sample
Patterns in atomic structure and properties
The temperature of all substances at room pressure

questions.question: How do metalloids differ from typical metals and typical nonmetals?
choices: They have some properties associated with each group
They occur only as radioactive gases
They are mixtures of two elements

questions.question: An element is in the same group as chlorine. Which property is most reasonably expected?
choices: It has chemical similarities associated with the group's valence pattern
It has the same mass as chlorine
It must be a gas at room temperature

questions.question: Which pair is most likely to have similar main-group chemical properties?
Across a period, atomic number rises by one at each step. What increases by one?
choices: The number of isotopes in nature
The number of neutrons in every atom
The number of protons in the nucleus

questions.question: An unfamiliar element readily conducts electricity and can be hammered into a sheet. Which classification best fits?
A student says every element in one group has the same atomic mass. What is the best correction?
choices: Only periods contain elements with mass
Atomic mass has no relationship to atoms
Group members share property patterns but have different proton counts and masses
